text: A FreeSWITCH channel that connects back over the outbound socket is handed to the endpoint whose X-Chappe-Call header it carries (variable_sip_h_X-Chappe-Call).
notes: connect_caller/3 and create_endpoint/1 get the channel of their own INVITE; the endpoint answers it

text: A channel whose X-Chappe-Call no endpoint waits for, or that carries none, is hung up.
notes: chappe behaviour: the socket gets execute hangup, then closes

text: The endpoint owner hears DTMF digits, the hangup with its cause, and the loss of the node the channel is on.
When the endpoint owner exits, the audio forks and session recordings it started are stopped and the channel is killed.
notes: uuid_audio_fork stop, then uuid_kill; the caller gets a BYE

text: Moving a caller to an endpoint or a SIP target does not re-INVITE the caller; the leg it had gets a BYE.
notes: replace_b/3 behind rtpengine: no INVITE reaches the caller, the old channel or callee gets BYE

text: A bridge that fails leaves the caller where it was.
notes: bridge/2 to a direct call returns not_anchored and the endpoint keeps its dialog

text: A conference process owns its room: the room stays up when every member left, until the conference stops.
notes: native: the chappe_mix room outlives its first caller and the next caller joins the same room

text: Members join and leave with events to the conference receivers, and can be muted, made deaf, played to and kicked, on both backends.
notes: {chappe_mrf_conf, Conf, {joined | left | talking, Member, _}}; fs operations are conference <name> api commands

text: A member that has to enter a PIN joins only with the right one.
notes: fs backend: play_collect for the PIN, bad_pin after the tries; the call of a member bridged for the purpose is hung up
